abstract: Alabama is a high-poverty state with permissive small-dollar credit regulation and one of the largest licenced alternative financial service provider (AFSP) markets in the United States. Using Alabama State Banking Department licencing data for 2011, 2014, 2015, 2016, and 2020, we estimate Poisson pseudo-maximum likelihood (PPML) models with high-dimensional fixed effects to examine conditional spatial associations between traditional financial institutions (TFIs), socioeconomic and demographic characteristics, and counts of deferred-presentment providers (payday lenders), small-loan providers, and pawnshops. Models are estimated at census-tract, ZIP-code, and county levels, and two-part hurdle models separate AFSP presence from conditional intensity. The results are more consistent with co-location than with a spatial-void account. Lagged credit-union intensity shows the most consistent positive association with AFSP counts across specifications, especially at the ZIP-code level, while lagged bank intensity is positive in most specifications, with significance concentrated on the ZIP-code intensity and tract-level entry margins. Population size and an inverted-U income gradient are the strongest predictors. Demographic associations are strongest at the tract level, especially Hispanic share, share aged 65 and over, and lower educational attainment, while Black share is not significant in the main PPML models. The findings underscore the importance of spatial scale for interpreting AFSP location. KEYWORDS: Alternative financial service providers traditional financial institutions payday spatial scale credit-market segmentation JEL CLASSIFICATION: G21 G23 Acknowledgements We sincerely appreciate the valuable feedback from peers in American Council on Consumer Interests (ACCI)’s Early-Career Professional Development Mentorship Program.
abstract_zh: 阿拉巴马州是一个高贫困州，其小额信贷监管较为宽松，并拥有美国规模最大的持牌替代性金融服务提供商（AFSP）市场之一。利用阿拉巴马州银行部2011年、2014年、2015年、2016年和2020年的许可数据，我们估计了具有高维固定效应的泊松伪最大似然（PPML）模型，以考察传统金融机构（TFIs）、社会经济与人口特征，以及延期付款提供商（发薪日贷款机构）、小额贷款机构和当铺数量之间的条件空间关联。模型在人口普查区、邮政编码区和县三个层面进行估计，两部分的障碍模型将AFSP的存在与条件强度区分开来。结果更支持共选址而非空间空白假说。滞后信用合作社强度与AFSP数量在各规格中呈现最一致的正向关联，尤其在邮政编码区层面；而滞后银行强度在大多数规格中为正，显著性集中于邮政编码区强度及人口普查区进入边际。人口规模和倒U型收入梯度是最强的预测因子。人口特征关联在人口普查区层面最强，尤其是西班牙裔占比、65岁及以上人口占比以及较低的教育程度，而黑人占比在主要PPML模型中不显著。研究结果强调了空间尺度对解释AFSP选址的重要性。关键词：替代性金融服务提供商；传统金融机构；发薪日贷款；空间尺度；信贷市场分割 JEL分类：G21 G23 致谢：我们衷心感谢美国消费者利益委员会（ACCI）早期职业专业发展导师计划中同行们的宝贵反馈。
title: The spatial distribution of alternative financial service providers in Alabama: a multi-scale analysis
title_zh: 阿拉巴马州替代性金融服务提供者的空间分布：多尺度分析

abstract: Using A-share listed firms from the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges between 2007 and 2021 as the research sample, this article examines the impact of merchant guild culture on the speed at which firms adjust towards their target level of tax avoidance. The baseline results show that merchant guild culture significantly accelerates the adjustment speed. Mechanism analyses show that merchant guild culture enhances adjustment speed by improving internal coordination efficiency and reducing agency costs. Further research reveals that the enhancing effect of merchant guild culture on the adjustment speed is more pronounced when the actual level of tax avoidance is below the target. The promoting effect of merchant guild culture on tax adjustment speed is more evident in firms where the chairman’s place of origin or birthplace matches the registered location of the listed firm, those facing stronger product market competition, and those located in regions with weaker tax enforcement. This article not only identifies a new factor influencing tax avoidance adjustments, addressing a gap in the existing literature, but also examines the economic consequences of merchant guild culture from the perspective of tax management, providing insights into how merchant guild culture shapes corporate behaviour. KEYWORDS: Merchant guild culture target level of tax avoidance adjustment speed corporate governance JEL CLASSIFICATION: H26 M14
abstract_zh: 以2007—2021年沪深A股上市公司为研究样本，本文考察了商帮文化对企业向目标避税水平调整速度的影响。基准结果表明，商帮文化显著加快了企业避税调整速度。机制分析显示，商帮文化通过提升内部协调效率和降低代理成本来加快调整速度。进一步研究发现，当实际避税水平低于目标水平时，商帮文化对调整速度的促进作用更为显著。商帮文化对避税调整速度的促进效应在董事长籍贯或出生地与上市公司注册地一致的企业、面临更强产品市场竞争的企业以及位于税收征管较弱地区的企业中更为明显。本文不仅识别了影响避税调整的新因素，弥补了现有文献的空白，还从税收管理视角考察了商帮文化的经济后果，为理解商帮文化如何塑造企业行为提供了启示。关键词：商帮文化；目标避税水平；调整速度；公司治理 JEL分类：H26；M14

abstract: We estimate the peer effects of paternity leave‐taking among male co‐workers using the 2006 Quebec paternity leave reform. Using high‐quality administrative data, we closely follow the birth date regression discontinuity research design of Dahl et al. (2014) who studied a similar reform in Norway in 1993 which resembles the Quebec reform. Depending on the length of follow‐up, we estimate that having a male co‐worker take paternity leave increases the probability that a father of a newborn takes leave by 3 to 6 percentage points. While the statistical significance of our findings differ from Dahl et al. (2014) using Norwegian data, these estimates are nevertheless consistent with the 11 percentage point increase they report.
abstract_zh: 我们利用2006年魁北克省陪产假改革，估算了男性同事间陪产假休假的同伴效应。借助高质量行政数据，我们紧密遵循Dahl等人（2014）的出生日期断点回归研究设计，该研究分析了1993年挪威一项与魁北克改革相似的改革。根据随访时间长短的不同，我们估计，有一位男性同事休陪产假会使新生儿父亲休陪产假的概率增加3至6个百分点。尽管我们研究结果的统计显著性与Dahl等人（2014）使用挪威数据得出的结论有所不同，但这些估计值仍与他们报告的11个百分点增幅相一致。
title: Peer effects at work on parental leave: Why is Papa not more involved?
title_zh: 工作中的同伴效应与育儿假：为何爸爸参与度不高？

abstract: The present article employs probate records to analyse private wealth accumulation and distribution in Montevideo between 1760 and 1825. The results reveal four major findings. Firstly, there was a sustained rise in average wealth over time, even in the face of independence‐related wars. Secondly, asset portfolios became more complex and urban‐oriented. Thirdly, wealth inequality declined over the period under study. Finally, Montevideo exhibited relatively low levels of inequality in comparison with other contemporary global regions. The distribution of urban real estate and enslaved individuals, in particular, became more equitable, revealing a distinctive pattern of slave ownership. Notwithstanding these more general improvements, the top decile continued to accumulate significant fortunes. The findings are consistent with the importance of frontier conditions, institutional frameworks, and warfare for understanding distributive outcomes in this setting. The case of Montevideo highlights the historical contingency of inequality trajectories over time.
abstract_zh: 本文利用遗嘱认证记录，分析了1760年至1825年间蒙得维的亚的私人财富积累与分配情况。研究结果揭示了四大主要发现。首先，即便在独立战争期间，平均财富也呈现出持续增长的趋势。其次，资产组合变得更加复杂且偏向城市导向。第三，在所研究期间，财富不平等程度有所下降。最后，与同期全球其他地区相比，蒙得维的亚的不平等水平相对较低。特别是城市房地产和被奴役人口的分配变得更加公平，显示出一种独特的奴隶所有权模式。尽管存在这些总体改善，但最富有的十分之一人口仍持续积累巨额财富。这些发现与边疆条件、制度框架和战争对理解该地区分配结果的重要性相吻合。蒙得维的亚的案例凸显了不平等轨迹随时间变化的历史偶然性。
title: Wealth and inequality in Spanish America, from colonial rule to the eve of independence in Montevideo
title_zh: 从殖民统治到独立前夕：西班牙美洲的财富与不平等——以蒙得维的亚为例

abstract: We provide direct evidence on how the public expects the government to satisfy its intertemporal budget constraint. In a representative survey of U.S. households, respondents expect only 45% of government debt to be financed by future primary surpluses and 23% to be rolled over indefinitely without ever generating surpluses, as if sustained by a bubble. Experts perceive an even larger bubble (37%). Beliefs respond to fundamentals: at a debt-to-GDP ratio of 150%, the perceived bubble shrinks to 15%. A New Keynesian model calibrated to these beliefs implies a 13% larger government spending multiplier.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于公众如何预期政府满足其跨期预算约束的直接证据。在一项具有代表性的美国家庭调查中，受访者预期仅有45%的政府债务将由未来基本盈余融资，而23%的债务将被无限期滚动而不产生任何盈余，仿佛由泡沫支撑。专家感知到的泡沫更大（37%）。信念对基本面因素有所反应：当债务与GDP之比达到150%时，感知到的泡沫缩小至15%。一个根据这些信念校准的新凯恩斯模型显示，政府支出乘数将增加13%。
title: Perceived Budget Constraint of the Government

abstract: This paper constructs a new annual panel for 14 Western countries over 1800–2016, linking homicide to alcohol consumption (by beverage type), drug offenses, deterrence, and education. The central innovation is the first harmonized long-run cross-country alcohol series that can be aligned with the major historical waves in lethal violence. Across graphical evidence, narratives, and multivariate panel regressions, homicide co-moves strongly with alcohol, while education, deterrence, and demography capture the broader institutional context. We interpret the estimates as suggestive long-run relationships and use them for a multivariate historical accounting of the post-war crime wave and subsequent decline.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个覆盖14个西方国家、时间跨度为1800年至2016年的新型年度面板数据，将凶杀案与酒精消费（按饮料类型）、毒品犯罪、威慑力量及教育水平联系起来。核心创新在于首次建立了与致命暴力主要历史浪潮相吻合的、协调一致的长期跨国酒精消费序列。通过图形证据、叙事分析和多元面板回归，凶杀案与酒精消费呈现强相关性，而教育、威慑及人口结构则捕捉了更广泛的制度背景。我们将这些估计解读为提示性的长期关系，并利用它们对战后犯罪浪潮及其后续下降进行多元历史核算。
title: From spirits to crime: two centuries of alcohol and homicide in the West
title_zh: 从烈酒到犯罪：西方两个世纪的酒精与凶杀

abstract: A simple production economy with nominal price rigidities explains several key asset pricing facts, including the average slopes and cyclicality of equity and interest rate term structures. Nominal rigidities amplify the procyclicality of dividends after negative productivity shocks and generate countercyclical inflation, as sluggish price adjustment leads to a gradual dividend recovery. Consequently, short-duration equities (bonds) have more (less) procyclical payoffs than their long-duration counterparts. Slow-moving consumption habits produce large, countercyclical risk prices, yielding realistic asset valuations. Extending Campbell–Cochrane preferences with both market- and home-consumption habits allows them to operate in production economies while preserving realistic macroeconomic dynamics.
abstract_zh: 一个具有名义价格刚性的简单生产经济模型，能够解释若干关键资产定价事实，包括股票和利率期限结构的平均斜率及其周期性。名义刚性放大了负向生产率冲击后股息的前瞻性周期性，并产生反周期的通货膨胀，因为价格调整迟缓导致股息逐步恢复。因此，短久期股票（债券）的支付比长久期对应物更具（更不）前瞻性周期性。缓慢变动的消费习惯产生大规模、反周期的风险价格，从而得出符合现实的资产估值。将Campbell–Cochrane偏好扩展至同时包含市场消费习惯和家庭消费习惯，使其能在生产经济中运作，同时保持现实宏观经济动态。
title: A New Keynesian model of the term structures of equity and bond returns
title_zh: 股票与债券收益率期限结构的新凯恩斯模型

abstract: The current opioid epidemic is the worst drug epidemic the U.S. has ever faced. We examine the role of social connections in its spatial spread. Having many friendship links to counties with high opioid exposure positively correlates with overdose death rates. To address identification concerns, we exploit two quasi-natural experiments that led users to substitute illicit opioids for prescription drugs. Having more friends exposed to counties affected by these shocks leads to more overdose deaths. We also provide suggestive evidence that spillovers affect different stages of addiction, are influenced by both supply- and demand-side conditions, and are attenuated in counties with more cohesive local friendship networks. Our results show how social connections contribute to the spread of the opioid epidemic.
abstract_zh: 当前阿片类药物危机是美国历史上最严重的药物流行病。我们考察了社会联系在其空间传播中的作用。与阿片类药物暴露水平较高的县拥有众多友谊链接，与过量死亡率的上升呈正相关。为解决识别问题，我们利用了两个准自然实验，这些实验导致使用者从处方药转向非法阿片类药物。更多朋友暴露于受这些冲击影响的县，会导致更多过量死亡。我们还提供了初步证据表明，溢出效应影响成瘾的不同阶段，受供需双方条件的影响，并在地方友谊网络更为紧密的县中有所减弱。我们的研究结果表明，社会联系如何促进阿片类药物流行病的传播。
title: Friends with drugs: The role of social networks in the opioid epidemic
title_zh: 毒品之友：社交网络在阿片类药物流行中的作用

abstract: The European Union's AI Act – the world’s most ambitious regulatory framework for artificial intelligence to date – was supposed to enter into full effect on 2 August 2026. But while the AI Act's transparency layer has come into effect, obliging providers to inform individuals when they interact with an AI system, its high-risk regime – covering biometric identification, recruitment systems, credit scoring, law enforcement, and border control – has been delayed. This column argues that the result is a double bind in which Europe loses regulatory sovereignty whether it enforces its own rules or retreats from them.
abstract_zh: 欧盟《人工智能法案》——迄今为止全球最具雄心的AI监管框架——原定于2026年8月2日全面生效。然而，尽管该法案的透明度条款已生效，要求提供商在个人与AI系统互动时告知对方，但其高风险制度——涵盖生物识别、招聘系统、信用评分、执法及边境管控——已被推迟。本专栏认为，其结果是一种双重困境：无论欧洲是执行自身规则还是退让回避，都将丧失监管主权。
title: Europe's regulatory double bind
